Use of the antibody fragments has also been effective in children with severe digitalis intoxication.11 Digoxin-specific antibody fragments have also been used suc- cessfully in poisoning due to preparations containing toad ven- om,12 or due to common or yellow oleander (see Oleander, p.2356). 1.
